Every item of the file becomes a new lab item (all or nothing).

Metadata only (title, abbreviation, description, tags); a field sent as null is
cleared, a field not sent is kept. The fragment is version-bound.

post.description: An editable lab copy of a bundled or host-shared item, remembering its origin.

get.description: The portable `*.osp-bank.json` file (one item, one version).

post.description:
Owner only. `host` shares with every lab on the host (unknown and licensed-to-lab
items are refused: 422 `bank.not_shareable`); `lab` takes it back.
Version n+1 of the lab's own item from a survey target; metadata not given is kept.

get.description: The allowed `settings.retention` policies (the builder's retention control).
Warnings about a survey draft's custom values judged by its lab's profile.

The property schemas with the lab's profile applied: the shape of
``GET /api/meta/property-schemas`` plus ``groupLabels``, ``defaults`` (per question
type, for new questions), ``profileApplied`` and the profile's ``diagnostics``.

post.description:
The participant agreed (semantics.md section 11). Until then the server takes no
snapshot, quota check or submit for a survey with a consent page.

The participant declined: the session is deleted. Nothing is kept but an
anonymous count, and only if the survey asks for one.

Mint a return token before sending the participant to an external task (task EX2).
The node must be an `externalTask` node of this survey.

The participant withdraws (before or after submitting): their response and
session are deleted, and an audit entry without answer data is written. The resume
token stops working.
